# Koott (koott.live)

> Koott helps Kerala and Indian students study in Australia. It matches students to in-demand courses using real Australian Government skills and occupation data, provides 485 visa and compliance tools, and connects students to city/university communities. Free to use — no agents, no commission.

## Key pages
- [Course Advisor](https://koott.live/advisor): AI tool that matches students to in-demand Australian courses with salary ranges and 485 visa pathways, using the Australian Skills Priority List.
- [Communities](https://koott.live/communities): City, university and intake chat rooms for Kerala and Indian students in Australia.
- [WhatsApp Groups](https://koott.live/whatsapp): Verified WhatsApp groups by city and intake.
- [Funding & Insurance](https://koott.live/funding): Education loan options, OSHC health cover, and cost-of-living budgeting.
- [Arrival Kit](https://koott.live/arrival): First-week checklist — bank account, Tax File Number (TFN), and transport by state.
- [Visa Tools](https://koott.live/tools): Cost calculator, work-hours (48 hrs/fortnight) and OSHC checks, application timeline.

## Guides (blog)
- [Study in Australia from Kerala: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://koott.live/blog/study-in-australia-from-kerala): Costs, IELTS, step-by-step timeline, the regional advantage, 485 visa and Malayali communities.
- [485 Visa Fee Increase 2026](https://koott.live/blog/485-visa-fee-increase): The Temporary Graduate visa fee rose to ~A$5,710 on 1 July 2026, after doubling to A$4,600 on 1 March 2026.
- [Regional Universities in Australia](https://koott.live/blog/regional-universities-australia): All 10 regional universities with indicative fees, IELTS and QS bands.
- [The 485 Visa Regional Bonus](https://koott.live/blog/485-visa-regional-bonus): How regional study adds 1–2 extra post-study work years.
- [Jobs in Regional Australia](https://koott.live/blog/jobs-regional-australia): In-demand occupations from the Skills Priority List and student work rules.
- [Why Regional Australia](https://koott.live/blog/why-regional-australia): The honest case — cost, admission, visa bonus, community.
- [Studying in Newcastle](https://koott.live/blog/study-in-newcastle): City guide for Indian students (UON).
- [Cost of Living: Regional vs Sydney & Melbourne](https://koott.live/blog/cost-of-living-regional-australia): Real budget comparison.

## Key facts
- Work limit for student visa holders: 48 hours per fortnight (verify current cap with Home Affairs).
- Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) is required for a student visa.
- 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa allows post-study work; regional graduates can get 1–2 extra years. Primary fee ~A$5,710 as of 1 July 2026.
- Cost-of-living financial requirement: approximately A$29,710 per year (Australian Department of Home Affairs).
- Regional cities for migration purposes include Adelaide, Newcastle, Wollongong, Hobart, Townsville and Darwin.

## Notes
- Audience: Kerala and Indian students planning to study in Australia.
- Data sources: Jobs and Skills Australia (JSA), ABS, Department of Home Affairs, CRICOS.
